'''Luciana Luna Anna Lomonaco''' is an Italian mathematician specialized in [[dynamical system]]s recognized by her works in [[topology]] and [[geometry]]. She is the first woman to receive the [[Brazilian Mathematical Society Award]]. This honor was achieved by working on [[mandelbrot set]]s.

== Early life ==
Lumonaco was born in [[Milan]], Italy. Her family moved from Milan to [[Peschiera del Garda]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2020-01-16 |title=Em seu sétimo país, 'cigana' Luna Lomonaco chega ao IMPA |url=https://impa.br/notices/em-seu-setimo-pais-cigana-luna-lomonaco-chega-ao-impa/ |access-date=2025-10-07 |website=IMPA - Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada |language=pt-BR |archive-date=23 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250523042155/https://impa.br/notices/em-seu-setimo-pais-cigana-luna-lomonaco-chega-ao-impa/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-07-30 |title=Luna Lomonaco é a primeira mulher a conquistar Prêmio SBM |url=https://impa.br/notices/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulher-a-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |access-date=2025-10-02 |website=IMPA - Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada |language=pt-BR |archive-date=5 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251205020344/https://impa.br/notices/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulher-a-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Lumonaco studied in a school focus on [[human science]]s. She studied [[Greek language|Greek]], [[Latin]] and [[philosophy]]. And because of philosophy she then studied mathematics, because, to her, the problems of mathematics could trigger important thoughts.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2022-08-29 |title=Conheça Luna Lomonaco, vencedora do prêmio da Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática |url=https://revistagalileu.globo.com/Ciencia/noticia/2019/08/conheca-luna-lomonaco-vencedora-do-premio-da-sociedade-brasileira-de-matematica.html |access-date=2025-10-02 |website=Revista Galileu |language=pt-br |archive-date=23 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250523052524/https://revistagalileu.globo.com/Ciencia/noticia/2019/08/conheca-luna-lomonaco-vencedora-do-premio-da-sociedade-brasileira-de-matematica.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Academic formation and career ==
Lomonaco graduated in mathematics from the [[University of Padua]], Italy. Then, she earn her master's degree from the [[Complutense University of Madrid]], Spain, and her PhD's title from [[Roskilde University]], Denmark,<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Luciana Luna Anna Lomonaco |url=https://serrapilheira.org/pesquisadores/luciana-luna-anna-lomonaco/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=Instituto Serrapilheira |language=pt-br |archive-date=10 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251110005636/https://serrapilheira.org/pesquisadores/luciana-luna-anna-lomonaco/ |url-status=live }}</ref> supervised by Carsten Lunde Petersen.<ref name=":3" />

After her PhD, she recognized gaps in her formation. Then, she obtained an opportunity to study in the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], where she began to recognize herself professionally. Still in China, an American professor recommended the [[University of São Paulo]].<ref name=":3" />

She arrived in Brazil on 24 April 2014 and became a professor at the [[Institute of Mathematics and Statistics, University of São Paulo]].<ref name=":0" /> Lumonaco taught a course of complex dynamic systems.<ref name=":3" />

In 2019, she became the first woman to ever receive the Brazilian Mathematical Society Award with the work ''On Quasi-Conformal (In-)Compatibility of Satellite Copies of the Mandelbrot Set: I'', published in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |last=CTIC |first=Coordenação de Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação- |title=Luna Lomonaco é a primeira mulhera conquistar Prêmio SBM |url=https://www.profmat.uema.br/2019/08/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulhera-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=Mestrado Profissional em Matemática |language=pt-br |archive-date=9 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250609082641/https://www.profmat.uema.br/2019/08/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulhera-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

She served as teacher at USP until 2020, when she went to the ''[[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]]''. With Carolina Araujo, they were the only woman in the institute where 47 researchers worked.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Destaque internacional |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/destaque-internacional/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |language=pt-br |archive-date=6 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250806221734/https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/destaque-internacional/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Lomonaco is interested in [[complex dynamics]] and mandelbrot sets, but also dedicates herself to scientific dissemination and to disseminate mathematics to women.<ref>{{Cite web |last=pedrolira |date=2020-05-06 |title=Luna Lomonaco: a língua dos números |url=https://serrapilheira.org/luna-lomonaco-a-lingua-dos-numeros/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=Instituto Serrapilheira |language=pt-br}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 2018: ''Prêmio Para Mulheres na Ciência.''<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-08-13 |title=Pesquisadoras da USP vencem prêmio para mulheres cientistas |url=https://jornal.usp.br/ciencias/pesquisadoras-da-usp-vencem-premio-para-mulheres-cientistas/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=Jornal da USP |archive-date=8 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250708145746/https://jornal.usp.br/ciencias/pesquisadoras-da-usp-vencem-premio-para-mulheres-cientistas/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 2019: Brazilian Mathematical Society Award.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-07-30 |title=Luna Lomonaco é a primeira mulher a conquistar Prêmio SBM |url=https://impa.br/notices/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulher-a-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=IMPA - Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada |language=pt-BR |archive-date=5 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251205020344/https://impa.br/notices/luna-lomonaco-e-a-primeira-mulher-a-conquistar-premio-sbm/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 2020: ''Prêmio de Reconhecimento União Matemática da América Latina e Caribe (Umalca).''<ref name=":1" />
* 2023: ''Prêmio Jovem Cientista.''<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-02-23 |title=Matemáticas recebem prêmios da FAPERJ de Jovem Cientista 2023 – SBM – Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática |url=https://sbm.org.br/noticias/matematicas-recebem-premios-da-faperj-de-jovem-cientista-2023/ |access-date=2025-10-03 |language=pt-BR |archive-date=8 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250708145741/https://sbm.org.br/noticias/matematicas-recebem-premios-da-faperj-de-jovem-cientista-2023/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* 2015: ''Parabolic-like mappings.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Lomonaco |first=Luna |date=2015 |title=Parabolic-like mappings |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/ergodic-theory-and-dynamical-systems/article/abs/paraboliclike-mappings/50A10ACB0F8E4D20C190A52C5C611C2E |journal=Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems |language=en |volume=35 |issue=7 |pages=2171–2197 |doi=10.1017/etds.2014.27 |issn=0143-3857}}</ref>
* 2017: ''On parabolic external maps.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Lomonaco |first1=Luna |last2=Petersen |first2=Carsten Lunde |last3=Shen |first3=Weixiao |date=2017-10-01 |title=On parabolic external maps |url=https://www.aimsciences.org/en/article/doi/10.3934/dcds.2017220 |journal=Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems |language=en |volume=37 |issue=10 |pages=5085–5104 |doi=10.3934/dcds.2017220 |issn=1078-0947|arxiv=1603.01609 }}</ref>
* 2017: ''On quasi-conformal (in-) compatibility of satellite copies of the Mandelbrot set: I.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Lomonaco |first1=Luna |last2=Petersen |first2=Carsten Lunde |date=2017-11-01 |title=On quasi-conformal (in-) compatibility of satellite copies of the Mandelbrot set: I |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |language=en |volume=210 |issue=2 |pages=615–644 |doi=10.1007/s00222-017-0737-1 |issn=1432-1297|arxiv=1505.05422 }}</ref>
* 2019: ''Mating quadratic maps with the modular group II.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Bullett |first1=Shaun |last2=Lomonaco |first2=Luna |date=2020 |title=Mating quadratic maps with the modular group II |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/s00222-019-00927-9 |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |language=en |volume=220 |issue=1 |pages=185–210 |doi=10.1007/s00222-019-00927-9 |issn=0020-9910|doi-access=free }}</ref>
* 2022: ''Dynamics of modular matings.''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Bullett |first1=Shaun |last2=Lomonaco |first2=Luna |date=2022-12-03 |title=Dynamics of modular matings |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0001870822005758 |journal=[[Advances in Mathematics]] |volume=410 |article-number=108758 |doi=10.1016/j.aim.2022.108758 |issn=0001-8708|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Lomonaco appreciates sea baths and practices singing. She is a fan of [[Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie]]'s books.<ref name=":2" />
